Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring ballot drop-off sites at institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ballot deposit sites; and adding a new sectionto chapter 29A.48 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At least one unstaffed ballot dropoff site shall be located ateach institution of higher education, as defined in RCW 28B.10.016. (2) "Ballot deposit site" means the site or sites designated by thecounty auditor in which a voter may deposit his or her ballot in asecure collection device on or before election day. (a) Staffed ballot deposit sites must be staffed by at least twopeople. Staffed deposit sites may be open prior to the electionaccording to dates and times established by the county auditor and, ifopen on election day, must be open from 7:00 a.m. until 8:00 p.m. (b) Unstaffed ballot deposit sites must consist of secured ballotboxes that allow return envelopes, once deposited, to only be removedby authorized staff. Unstaffed ballot deposit sites must be available p. 1 HB 2843to receive ballots from eighteen days prior to an election until 8:00p.m. on election day.
